name: Exhuma
stack: Strict TypeScript Universal Component Platform Monorepo: Next.js 15, React 19, Vue 3, Astro, Laravel Blade, Vanilla JS, WordPress Gutenberg Block API v3, Web Components, Tailwind CSS, Vitest, Playwright; Node 24.20.0, pnpm 11.2.2.
protectedBoundaries: Universal Component Model (UCM) separates pure headless math from framework rendering.
Zero memory leaks in Vanilla JS and Web Components: strict destroy() lifecycle tearing down observers and listeners.
Scoped CSS layers (@layer exhuma) preventing host application or theme collisions.
Zero broken code snippets: every registry code string must compile in CI without errors.
Upstream-managed workflow files remain checksum-identical; project context and task history remain consumer-owned.
notes: Inspect root package.json for subcommands. Available means implemented. Builds require compiled libraries; test requires Vitest; full quality gates run in CI via auterix-verify.yml.
